description: Tarteel brings deep Quranic study into ChatGPT. Read any ayah with translations from 50+ languages or detailed tafsir commentary from 20+ scholarly collections. Search the Quran by Arabic text with diacritic-insensitive matching, explore repeated phrases (mutashabihat) across the Mushaf, and listen to recitations by 17+ renowned reciters including Al-Husary, Al-Minshawi, and Abdul Basit. Get accurate Islamic prayer times for any city worldwide. Every piece of content is drawn from verified scholarly sources — trustworthy, faithful to the tradition, and ready whenever you need it.
